technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure but no near-term reversal confirmation; price trapped below all short-term MAs with bearish momentum—high risk of further downside before any bounce.

fundamental.summary: AEP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 41 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is stale (6+ months old) and non-convictional; no recent news sentiment to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (406.4), flat yield curve, FOMC event just passed, and moderate earnings risk in 41 days create a highly unfavourable macro environment for AEP.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI across all periods, Williams %R, Stochastic) combined with long-term MA bullish alignment (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200, Supertrend) and contrarian fear-zone opportunity present classic reversal setup for contrarian traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is trapped below all short-term moving averages with zero near-term momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, no bullish crossovers, OBV not rising), no fundamental catalysts, no insider/institutional conviction, and crisis-level macro headwinds (VIX 406.4, FOMC just passed, earnings risk in 41 days) make this a high-risk entry with unfavourable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold conditions present contrarian opportunity, but price is trapped below all short-term moving averages with zero momentum confirmation and no near-term reversal signal to justify entry timing.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level macro environment (VIX 406.4, FOMC just passed) combined with earnings risk in 41 days and complete absence of fundamental/insider conviction creates high probability of further downside before any bounce materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents see contrarian opportunity, but fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly reject entry due to macro headwinds and lack of catalysts
